note: Config for champion-move tracking: risk, fraud and compliance leaders who leave a publicly named Sardine customer for a new role. Searches run in Clay; results are reviewed privately and no names are stored in this repo.

scoring.rule: Every champion move stays on the list. Enforcement is a bonus flag, never a filter.
scoring.enforcement_lookup: for each new employer, check the tracker, the Fed and OCC feeds, and a targeted web search (FDIC, FinCEN, state regulators, CFPB, CFTC/SEC for non-banks); an open action or a sponsor bank under order moves the lead to the top
scoring.segment_fit: use the tracker's segment weights to order the rest

coverage_note: 65 domains: every name in known_customers.json except Heritage Bank and Portage Bank, where several banks share the name and the right one can't be confirmed.
